rus-church-12.see: A log-walled room with vertical plank wood flooring containing a wooden iconostasis screen against the back wall, several tall metal candelabras, a small lectern holding an open icon or book, and a wooden plank door with iron strap hinges.
rus-church-12.culture: Slavic / Russian, medieval to early modern (Eastern Orthodox)
rus-church-12.wrong: Two candelabras on the right overlap and clip into one another; a pale grey box/mesh clips through the wall behind the crest of the iconostasis; icons and book text are blurry and illegible; left and right side walls are missing.

mde-audience-12.see: An orange terracotta-tiled room with plastered walls featuring horseshoe arch niches and mashrabiya windows, furnished with perimeter cushioned divans, a low brass tea table, and a central octagonal stone fountain placed on an ornate rug.
mde-audience-12.culture: Middle Eastern / Moorish Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-audience-12.wrong: The stone water fountain sits directly on top of a fabric carpet; a cropped white graphic fragment floats in the upper-left margin; side walls are missing.

nrs-meadhall-12.see: A wooden palisade hall with a straw-strewn dirt floor featuring a carved wooden high-seat throne facing an animal skin rug between two long stone charcoal hearths, flanked by racks of round shields, benches, a trestle table, and an isolated wooden post.
nrs-meadhall-12.wrong: The animal skin rug lies paper-thin on top of the dirt texture; the carved wooden post stands isolated supporting nothing; a cropped green letter 'K' floats in the top-left margin; side walls are missing.

mes-shrine-12.see: A stone-tiled sanctuary with mural-painted walls and a woven doorway curtain, housing a carved stone altar laden with food offerings flanked by two large painted braziers, with a reclining Chacmool statue resting on a woven mat in front.
mes-shrine-12.wrong: Offerings include bananas/plantains (an Old World post-Columbian crop); the lower right wall panel has a blurry and misaligned texture; side walls are missing.
